368: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
369:     predicate {
370:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
371:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
372: 
373:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
374:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
375:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
376: 
377:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
378:             &&& self.update.is_none()
379:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
380:         })
381: 
382:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
383:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
384:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
385:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
386:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
387: 
388:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
389:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
390:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
391:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
392:         })
393: 
394:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
395:             &&& self.update.is_none()
396:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
397:         })
398: 
399:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Response() ==> {
400:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
401:             &&& update.value().is_Done()
402:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
403:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
404: 
405:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
406:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
407:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
408:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().resp matches Some(resp)

587: pub open spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
588:     predicate {
589:         &&& 0 < self.num_replicas@ <=  MAX_REPLICAS
590: 
591:         &&& self.local_versions.len() == self.num_replicas
592: 
593:         &&& self.slog.len() == LOG_SIZE
594:         &&& self.slog.len() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.buffer_size()
595:         &&& self.slog.len() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.cell_ids().len()
596:         &&& (forall |i| #![trigger self.slog[i]] 0 <= i < self.slog.len() ==> {
597:             &&& self.slog[i].log_entry.id() == (#[trigger]self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.cell_ids()[i])
598:         })
599: 
600:         &&& (forall |i: nat| i < LOG_SIZE ==> (#[trigger] self.slog[i as int]).wf(i, self.cyclic_buffer_instance@))
601: 
602:         &&& self.unbounded_log_instance@.num_replicas() == self.num_replicas
603:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.num_replicas() == self.num_replicas
604:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.unbounded_log_instance() == self.unbounded_log_instance
605:     }
606: 
607:     invariant on version_upper_bound with (unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.version_upper_bound.0) is (v: u64, g: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>) {
608:         &&& g.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
609:         &&& g.value() == v
610:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
611:     }
612: 
613:     invariant on head with (cyclic_buffer_instance) specifically (self.head.0) is (v: u64, g: CyclicBuffer::head<DT>) {
614:         &&& g.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
615:         &&& g.value() == v
616:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
617:     }
618: 
619:     invariant on tail with (cyclic_buffer_instance, unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.tail.0) is (v: u64, g: (UnboundedLog::tail<DT>, CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>)) {
620:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
621:         &&& g.0.value() == v
622:         &&& g.1.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
623:         &&& g.1.value() == v
624:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
625:     }
626: 
627:     invariant on local_versions with (unbounded_log_instance, cyclic_buffer_instance)
628:         forall |i: int|
629:         where (0 <= i < self.local_versions@.len())
630:         specifically (self.local_versions@[i].0)
631:         is (v: u64, g: (UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>)) {
632: 
633:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
634:         &&& g.0.key() == i
635:         &&& g.0.value() == v
636:         &&& g.1.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
637:         &&& g.1.key() == i
638:         &&& g.1.value() == v
639:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
640:     }
641: }
642: }
